visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled black hair and a black The North Face puffer vest over a blue jacket looks upward with a curious expression. The setting is a brightly lit indoor retail store with blurred clothing racks in the background. (2) A montage of close-up shots displays various sale price tags. One white sign shows '600元' and '買一送一', while others indicate '2折', 'SALE 1999', and '1折'. The signs are attached to metal clothing racks. (3) The man, now wearing a tan Columbia hooded parka, addresses the camera directly. He smiles and gestures with his right index finger. He is positioned in front of a white wall featuring blue and black graphics. (4) An exterior shot shows the glass facade of the '日曜天地 OUTLET' building. A large interior banner is displayed with the text '戶外山海祭' and dates '12.26 - 1.12', featuring images of outdoor gear like boots and bottles. (5) The man tries on a black Timberland jacket in front of a mirror, smiling at his reflection. He points to a red sign that says '3折' and '70% OFF'. He is seen zipping up the jacket, which has multiple pockets. (6) The man stands amidst dense racks of colorful clothing, including pink and yellow jackets. He points toward the camera with a playful smile. The lighting is bright and even throughout the retail environment. (7) Close-up shots focus on price tags for The North Face gear, displaying numbers like '1999', '12000', and '1500'. The man's hands are seen pointing at specific details on the printed signs and clothing labels. (8) The man walks between rows of trousers on hangers. He then puts on a red and grey Eider jacket and a white backpack. He looks toward the side with a serious, adventurous expression. (9) The man sits on a chair at a wooden table in front of a tan Snow Peak tent. He holds a black cup and a stainless steel kettle. A sign on the table reads 'Snow Peak 全商品 7折'. (10) The man is shown from the shoulder up, checking a price tag held by another person whose hands are visible. He turns to the camera with wide eyes and a look of extreme surprise and joy. (11) The man stands in front of a display wall for Wildland, holding up a dark green jacket on a hanger. He points to the jacket while speaking. Rows of colorful jackets are visible on the left. (12) The man wears a thick, brown and black North Face parka with a fur-lined hood. He rubs his hands together near his face. White particle effects resembling falling snow are overlaid on the video frame. (13) The man stands in front of a wall with The North Face logo and mannequins. He delivers a concluding message, pointing at the camera. He wears a black and blue vest over a black sweater.

The background music is an upbeat pop-electronic track with a prominent bass beat around 125 BPM. (3) A comedic 'pop' or 'bubble' sound effect triggers as the speaker gestures. The BGM continues at a consistent volume. The speaker's vocal delivery remains projected and energetic, emphasizing specific words like 'one-fold' with rising intonation and increased intensity. (4) A 'ding' notification sound effect is heard as a transition occurs. The male narration continues, zipping sounds of a jacket being closed are audible over the BGM. The ambient floor is studio-clean with no significant background noise interference, suggesting high-quality production. (5) A comedic, exaggerated male vocal sound effect with wide pitch modulation plays. This is followed by a short snippet of female speech in a calm, informative tone. The primary male narrator resumes, his voice reflecting shock and excitement with high spectral brightness. (6) A distinct wind-like whoosh SFX accompanied by soft, high-frequency 'shimmering' sounds plays during a scene change. The BGM remains steady. The male voice continues to deliver information about brands, maintaining a professional yet persuasive narrative style with clear articulation. (7) The final phase features a percussive crescendo in the background music. The male speaker's arousal level peaks as he gives a final call to action. The audio concludes with a sharp fade out of both the music and the vocal track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the 'Outdoor Mountain and Sea Festival' sale event at Sunshine Outlet in Taichung. It uses a high-energy vlog format to showcase significant discounts (up to 90% off) on popular outdoor brands to entice shoppers.
